name: @spell-app/brand
description: Spell's brand:  Claude Design's pages and tokens, their Spell UI copies, and the <brand-*> elements they need (a component pack)

scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint:fix && yarn format && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
scripts.ts:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TSC' && spell-types --below && spell-types && tsc -p ./tests && echo '<< TSC PASSED
'
scripts.lint:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT' && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 src components scripts && cd ./tests && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 . && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.lint:fix:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT --fix' && vp lint --fix src components scripts && cd ./tests && vp lint --fix . && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.format:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> FORMATTING WITH OXFMT' && vp fmt src components scripts vite.config.ts vite.design.config.ts vitest.config.ts _assets/brand-pages.js _assets/brand-pages.css && cd ./tests && vp fmt . && echo '<< OXFMT PASSED
'
scripts.test:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TESTS' && vp test run && echo '<< TESTS PASSED
'
